novel_policies.label: apprentice supervision ratio
novel_policies.quote: rules made by the commission, with the concurrence of the director, in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act, regarding the ratio of apprentices allowed under the immediate supervision of a licensed supervisor, including the ratio of apprentices in their fourth year of training or later that are allowed to be under the immediate supervision of a licensed supervisor

novel_policies.label: apprentice unsupervised hours allowed
novel_policies.quote: beginning in a licensed apprentice electrician's fourth year of training, a licensed apprentice electrician may work without supervision for a period not to exceed eight hours in any 24-hour period

novel_policies.label: apprentice unsupervised year threshold
novel_policies.quote: beginning in a licensed apprentice electrician's fourth year of training, a licensed apprentice electrician may work without supervision for a period not to exceed eight hours in any 24-hour period

novel_policies.label: approved continuing education providers
novel_policies.quote: The commission may only approve courses for continuing education if offered by: ... the National Electrical Contractors Association Intermountain Chapter; ... the Independent Electrical Contractors of Utah; ... the Intermountain Electrical Association

novel_policies.label: electrician continuing education hours
novel_policies.quote: a licensed electrician shall complete 16 hours of continuing education under the continuing education program established under this section

novel_policies.label: expedited licensure pathway available
novel_policies.quote: meets the qualifications for expedited licensure as established by rules made by the commission, with the concurrence of the director, in accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act, that clearly demonstrate the applicant has the knowledge and skills to be a licensed master electrician

novel_policies.label: financial responsibility bond option
novel_policies.quote: submitting a bond in an amount and form determined by the commission with the concurrence of the director

novel_policies.label: gas appliance work certification required
novel_policies.quote: Any person described in Subsection (2)(b) that performs work described in Subsection (2)(a): must first receive training and certification as specified in rules adopted by the commission

novel_policies.label: hot tub sign electrical exemption
novel_policies.quote: a person involved in minor electrical work incidental to a mechanical or service installation, including the outdoor installation of: an above-ground, prebuilt hot tub; or the installation, maintenance, or repair of on-premise signs

novel_policies.label: journeyman electrician apprenticeship hours
novel_policies.quote: has successfully completed at least four years of full-time training and instruction as a licensed apprentice electrician under the supervision of a master electrician or journeyman electrician and in accordance with a planned training program approved by the division

novel_policies.label: journeyman electrician experience alternative years
novel_policies.quote: has at least eight years of full-time experience approved by the division in collaboration with the Electricians and Plumbers Licensing Board

novel_policies.label: license tiers
novel_policies.quote: The division shall issue licenses under this chapter to qualified persons in the following classifications: ... apprentice electrician; ... journeyman electrician; ... master electrician; ... residential electrical contractor; residential journeyman electrician; ... residential master electrician

novel_policies.label: does not require continuing education
novel_policies.quote: If continuing education or other requirements are made a condition of license reinstatement after lapse, suspension, or revocation, these requirements must be satisfied before the license is reissued.

novel_policies.label: degree level: bachelor
novel_policies.quote: be a graduate of a four-year electrical course offered by an accredited college or university

novel_policies.label: degree level: high school
novel_policies.quote: Either completion of high school or a high school equivalent

novel_policies.label: long term compliance qualifier waiver years
novel_policies.quote: If a plumbing or electrical business entity has maintained its license and has not violated the requirements of this chapter ... for a period of five consecutive years, the business entity may maintain its license under this chapter by recording an active employee name and registration/license number from the applicable trade on the renewal application

novel_policies.label: master electrician engineering degree pathway
novel_policies.quote: is a graduate electrical engineer of an accredited college or university approved by the division and has one year of practical electrical experience as a licensed apprentice electrician

novel_policies.label: master electrician journeyman experience years
novel_policies.quote: has four years of practical experience as a journeyman electrician

novel_policies.label: master electrician trade school degree pathway
novel_policies.quote: is a graduate of an electrical trade school, having received an associate of applied sciences degree following successful completion of a course of study approved by the division, and has two years of practical experience as a licensed journeyman electrician

novel_policies.label: minor electrical work amperage limit
novel_policies.quote: minor electrical work incidental to a mechanical or service installation when wiring is extended to no more than 10 feet from an existing outlet or disconnect and does not exceed 120 volts and 20 amperes

novel_policies.label: minor electrical work distance limit feet
novel_policies.quote: minor electrical work incidental to a mechanical or service installation when wiring is extended to no more than 10 feet from an existing outlet or disconnect

novel_policies.label: national electrical code reference
novel_policies.quote: work involving class two or class three power-limited circuits as defined in the National Electrical Code

novel_policies.label: residential journeyman training program years: 3
novel_policies.quote: an applicant for a residential journeyman electrician license shall have at least three years' experience, acceptable to the board, in the electrical trade.

novel_policies.label: public liability insurance required
novel_policies.quote: proof of public liability insurance in coverage amounts and form established by rule except for a construction trades instructor for whom public liability insurance is not required

novel_policies.label: qualifier license requirement by contractor type
novel_policies.quote: for residential electrical contractor licensure, the qualifier shall hold a master electrician or master residential electrician license; for electrical contractor licensure, the qualifier shall hold a master electrician license

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement grace period days
novel_policies.quote: If notice is given, the license shall remain in force for 60 days after the date of cessation of association or employment. The licensee shall replace the original qualifier with another individual qualifier within the 60-day period or the license shall be automatically suspended.

novel_policies.label: qualifier replacement notice days
novel_policies.quote: the licensee shall notify the division in writing within 10 days after cessation of association or employment

novel_policies.label: qualifier required
novel_policies.quote: The division shall require a contractor to have a qualifier. A qualifier for a contractor shall demonstrate to the division that the qualifier is: licensed in accordance with this chapter; and an owner, officer, or manager of the contractor who exercises material authority in the conduct of the contracting business

novel_policies.label: residential apprentice supervisor ratio max
novel_policies.quote: a licensed supervisor may have up to three licensed apprentice electricians on a residential project, or more if established by rules made by the commission, in concurrence with the director

novel_policies.label: residential journeyman training program years
novel_policies.quote: has successfully completed two years of training in an electrical training program approved by the division

novel_policies.label: residential master electrician journeyman experience years
novel_policies.quote: has at least two years of practical experience as a residential journeyman electrician

novel_policies.label: residential project definition
novel_policies.quote: "Residential project," as it relates to an electrician or electrical contractor, means buildings primarily wired with nonmetallic sheathed cable, in accordance with standard rules and regulations governing this work, including the National Electrical Code, and in which the voltage does not exceed 250 volts line to line and 125 volts to ground.

novel_policies.label: residential wiring method restriction
novel_policies.quote: "Residential journeyman electrician" means a person licensed under this chapter as a residential journeyman electrician having the qualifications, training, experience, and knowledge to wire, install, and repair electrical apparatus and equipment for light, heat, power, and other purposes on buildings using primarily nonmetallic sheath cable.

novel_policies.label: scope exclusions
novel_policies.quote: "Electrical trade" does not include: transporting or handling electrical materials; preparing clearance for raceways for wiring; work commonly done by unskilled labor on any installations under the exclusive control of electrical utilities; work involving cable-type wiring that does not pose a shock or fire-initiation hazard; work involving class two or class three power-limited circuits as defined in the National Electrical Code; or minor electrical work incidental to a mechanical or service installation when wiring is extended to no more than 10 feet from an existing outlet or disconnect and does not exceed 120 volts and 20 amperes.

novel_policies.label: small project dollar threshold exemption
novel_policies.quote: subject to Subsection 58-1-401(2) and Sections 58-55-501 and 58-55-502, a person engaged in the alteration, repair, remodeling, or addition to or improvement of a building with a contracted or agreed value of less than $7,000, including both labor and materials

novel_policies.label: solar panel electrical work exemption
novel_policies.quote: a solar panel worker if the construction trade is electrical work incidental to installing or repairing a solar panel

novel_policies.label: utility worker exemption
novel_policies.quote: a person who ordinarily would be subject to the electrician licensure requirements under this chapter when employed by: railroad corporations, telephone corporations or their corporate affiliates, elevator contractors or constructors, or street railway systems; or public service corporations, rural electrification associations, or municipal utilities who generate, distribute, or sell electrical energy for light, heat, or power

novel_policies.label: voltage limit residential
novel_policies.quote: in which the voltage does not exceed 250 volts line to line and 125 volts to ground

novel_policies.label: workers compensation insurance required
novel_policies.quote: proof of workers' compensation insurance that covers employees of the applicant in accordance with applicable Utah law

novel_policies.label: has advisory board
novel_policies.quote: There is hereby established the Committee of Electrical Examiners which shall consist of seven (7) members.

novel_policies.label: does not require bonding
novel_policies.quote: If a local jurisdiction requires a master electrician or other person who engages in the business of providing electrical services to execute a bond to the local jurisdiction, the applicant may satisfy the bond requirement by submitting proof of the insurance required under this section.

novel_policies.label: school approval basis: national accreditor
novel_policies.quote: apprenticeship training program registered by the office of apprenticeship of the United States department of labor

novel_policies.label: does not require moral character
novel_policies.quote: amended Subsec. (a) by deleting "is of good moral character,"

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a department
novel_policies.quote: "department" means the Department of Commerce, Community, and Economic Development

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a division
novel_policies.quote: The Idaho electrical board, hereinafter known as the board, is hereby created and made a part of the division of occupational and professional licenses.
